title: A Chicago spiderwort
done: You made a spiderwort! Each flower opens in the morning and closes in the afternoon.

steps.say: Put a yellow square flat on the table. It is the middle.
Put a blue triangle on top. A petal!
Put a blue triangle on the left side.
Put a blue triangle on the right side. A spiderwort has three petals.
Put a green square under the middle. The stem.
Put a tall green triangle on the left of the stem. A long leaf.
Put a tall green triangle on the right of the stem. Another long leaf.
